name: Logical topics
summary: Partition by subject matter. Use when the corpus is a pile of reference material about distinct subjects and nothing is 'running'.
when_to_use: Files cluster cleanly by subject (prefixes, titles, citation webs).
Nothing has ongoing state — these are documents, not workspaces.
The owner says 'these dossiers/briefs/notes are a mess'.
partitioning_rubric: Partition by subject; prefer few broad topics over many narrow ones.
Topic folders get AGENTS.md (scope: what belongs here, what does not) but NOT STATE.md — topics have no state.
Cite titles and heads, not just names, when classifying: an ambiguous filename with a clear head goes by the head.
Files with no signal (empty, scraps, binary with opaque names) go to 'unresolved', never guessed.

folder_template.agents_md_skeleton:
# <Topic>

## Scope
<what belongs here>

## Not in scope
<where related things went instead>

## Key files
- <the 2-5 files a newcomer should read first>

example.research/market-reports: market share dossiers on acme and globex
